title: Insha ya Masimulizi (Theme 10: Kudhibiti itikadi za kidini na za kijamii)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans insha ya masimulizi before writing: the parts in order, then one idea at a time, then checks it against the type.

floor.prerequisite: Writes a correct sentence with a capital letter and a kikomo.
floor.question: Andika sentensi moja kuhusu shule yako.

representations: a model text with its parts labelled
steps: Read the title and say the type.
Check against the checklist and correct.
contexts: a letter or story for a family member

board.say: Insha hii ni ya aina gani, na itakuwa na sehemu zipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the three-box plan for "Siku Bibi Alipoacha Imani Potovu".

listen_for: Imani potovu ni mawazo yasiyo ya kweli.
misconceptions.ask: Ni nani anafanya nini katika sentensi hii?
misconceptions.repair: Masimulizi husimulia matukio yaliyotokea: nani, wapi, nini kilitokea.

listen_for: Bibi anaamini kuwa paka mweusi huleta mkosi.
misconceptions.ask: Jambo hili lilitokea lini? Kitenzi kinaonyesha wakati gani?
misconceptions.repair: Jambo lililotokea husimuliwa kwa wakati uliopita: -li-.

listen_for: bibi alimfuga paka, bibi alielewa, mwalimu alieleza ukweli, bibi aliogopa paka
misconceptions.repair: Panga matukio yanavyofuatana, na utumie maneno kama kwanza, kisha na hatimaye.

misconceptions.ask: Msomaji anajifunza nini katika aya ya mwisho?
misconceptions.repair: Hitimisho hufunga insha kwa kueleza funzo au hisia, si kwa neno "Mwisho" tu.

misconceptions.ask: Ni neno lipi hapa si la Kiswahili sanifu?
misconceptions.repair: Insha huandikwa kwa Kiswahili sanifu, bila maneno ya Kiingereza wala Sheng.

checks.question: Ni sentensi ipi inafaa katika insha ya masimulizi kuhusu "Siku Bibi Alipoacha Imani Potovu"?
checks.answer: Bibi aliamini kuwa paka mweusi huleta mkosi.

checks.question: Insha ya masimulizi ina sehemu zipi?
